title: Accordion
description: A stack of headings that each open a section of content. The chevron morphs as a section opens or closes.
pageTitle: Accessible Accordion with Animated Chevron | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it for FAQs, product details, settings and any long content people want to scan before reading. Only the sections they open take up space. The morphing chevron makes it clear which sections are open.
whenToUse.alt: Animated accordion component: chevron icon morphs as each section opens and closes

accessibility: Each trigger is a native button inside a heading, with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
Closed panels are fully hidden from screen readers and the tab order.
The chevron animation is driven by `aria-expanded`, so what you see always matches what screen readers announce.
The height animation is skipped with `prefers-reduced-motion`.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: One accordion item
fragments.note: aria-expanded is the state. The icon reads it off the button through target.

fragments.title: Open and close on click
fragments.note: Flip the attribute, then move the text and the panel. No icon in sight.

fragments.title: Animate the panel height
fragments.note: Measure, animate, then hand the height back to the stylesheet.

fragments.title: Chevron colour, and the panel that clips
fragments.note: Colour changes at once. The shrinking panel is what hides the text.
